title: A Novel Classifier Based on Urinary Proteomics for Distinguishing Between Benign and Malignant Ovarian Tumors.
summary: The primary study reports diagnostic discrimination for the classifier on its tumor cohort. External prospective performance and clinical benefit are not established.
ai_technology: Machine-learning analysis of urinary-proteomics profiles classified ovarian tumors as benign or malignant.
organization: School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, Zhejiang Chinese Medical University, Hangzhou, China

evidence.tested: The primary study reports diagnostic discrimination for the classifier on its tumor cohort.
evidence.unknown: External prospective performance and clinical benefit are not established.
